# Budget Book

> Budget Book is a free, open-source (MIT) budget management web app for individuals and organizations. It is self-hosted on MySQL and built with React, Redux Toolkit, Express and Knex.

## What it does

- Monthly budgets split by category, with planned, spent and remaining amounts
- Expense and transaction tracking with search and filters
- Bill splitting between group members, with settlement history
- Month-end spending forecast based on the current run rate and past months
- Reminders and notes
- Personal and organization workspaces with owner, admin and member roles

## Integrations

- Excel (.xlsx) and CSV import and export
- PDF monthly reports
- Google Sheets live feed through IMPORTDATA
- Calendar feed (.ics) for Google Calendar, Outlook and Apple Calendar
- Slack, Discord and generic webhook notifications, compatible with Zapier and Make
